name: infrared
description: Claude Code plugins for Infrared, Darkshift's software factory for people who work with agents.

plugins.name: infrared-change
plugins.description: Infrared's change conventions as skills and hooks: a branch of its own for each Change, conventional commits, the pull request's body, evidence, the verdict, the progress entry, the hand-off and the rollout-flag lifecycle; a hook that refuses a commit whose subject is not conventional, and one that asks for the pull request's body before a builder session in ir local work ends.
